note: All telegraph art is UNLIT (emissive). *_glow files are ADDITIVE (colour = strength; alpha 0/255; draw on fxGlow with opacity 1). The rest is opaque (normal blend, alphaTest 0.5). The _n.png files are flat +Z pairs only.
floorRemapNote: RENDER (render C2, 12.11.2026): the floor pieces (tank_floor_glow, tank_floor_mark: the tank's landing zone, a primed barrel's and a lit belt's reach) are recoloured at load from the drawn blood reds to a hot hazard amber (a glowing target, not a liquid), exact colour to colour, alpha kept: a red pool on the floor beside a charred heap read as blood by a body (docs/trailer/CUT1_REVIEW.md, shots 17-18). The PNGs are untouched; the aim line in the air keeps its reds.

aimLine.method: PREFERRED: per pixel. Rasterise the 1-px centre line (lineRuns / Bresenham), thicken to 2 px ACROSS the major axis (shallow |dx|>=|dy|: the pixel + the one below; steep: the pixel + the one to the right; the integrator code draws n x 2 runs, which thins a steep aim to 1 px wide), core tones HI (upper/left row) and MID, a 2-px HOT bead every 16 px marching 1 px a sim tick toward the target; then every empty pixel within chebyshev 5 of the core takes aim_glow_ramp[d] (row 0 steady, row 1 blink), ONCE (max, never a sum: overlapping per-run glow quads double up at every step). Reference: telegraph.aim_line_pixels.

ramp.col: chebyshev distance d (0 = under the core)

frames.1: BLINK (last 12 ticks, alternate 0/1 at 12 Hz: the line never goes off, it flashes hot; if RENDER keeps an off phase, draw frame 1 in the on phase)

glow.note: additive; anchor x = landing x, row 8 = the floor top row (rows 0-7 air, 8-11 the floor face); frame 1 = the pulse (alternate 0/1 at 5 Hz, the integrator code pulses at 3 Hz: either)

mark.note: opaque, row 2 on the floor top row; frame 1 with the glow pulse

star: no star or symbol of any kind in any telegraph piece (an enemy triggers them)
